text: player

As Fuuka Minami's temporary secretary, besides keeping the preparations for the anniversary celebration on track, there is another task that requires my regular attention: Making progress reports to Fuuka Minami.

I sort through the twists and turns I went through recently. Luckily, I managed to complete everything without encountering any real issues. After that, I carefully knock on the door at Bamboo Cloud's top floor.
Come in.

The room is elegantly furnished in a vintage style, with two octagonal chandeliers hanging above. Fuuka Minami is seated at the desk right in front of me, her outline blurred by the sunlight coming through the open window behind her, and through that very window, the distant Champion Street is fully in view.
Fuuka Minami
I was just asking Ume why you weren't here yet, and if she was keeping you from me... And here you are.
Fuuka Minami casually tosses her phone to the corner of the table, props her head up with her hand, and asks me.
How's everything coming along?
The ritual was a success, so the ceremony on the day of the anniversary celebration should be good to go. As for the auction house...
I look up at Fuuka Minami, who was involved in the entire incident... Seeing that she's still calm and doesn't look angry anymore, I brace myself and continue.
As you know, we managed to retrieve the Heart of Divinity, and Ms. Ume has increased the security at the auction house. So, it should be smooth sailing from now on...
Sigh...
Fuuka Minami suddenly closes her folding fan and lets out a long sigh.
What's wrong?
I knew I should have trained my own secretary. Ume's influence has made your reports so stiff and boring.
Why don't you tell me something interesting? Like a happy moment you had at work?
A happy moment? Uh... Everyone's been really nice, and I enjoy working with them. Does that count?

Haha, of course! I'm actually quite surprised you're so good at handling interpersonal relationships. To be frank, I received Ume and A-Yuan's reports before you arrived, and they were really singing your praises.
Haha! Well, you know... Managing relationships in the workplace is an important aspect of the job.
Oh? I see...
Fuuka Minami chuckles and taps my chest with the tip of her folding fan.
Since managing your relationships in the workplace is an important aspect of the job... That includes our relationship, right?
